'''Holt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Holt first appeared in the [[2010]] published graphic novella ''[[Star Wars Adventures: The Will of Darth Vader]]'', which was written by [[Tom Taylor]].
The penciller of this comic was [[Brian Koschak]].
